triggers.name: party_auth_link_history
triggers.definition: CREATE TRIGGER party_auth_link_history BEFORE DELETE OR UPDATE ON party_auth_links FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION party_auth_link_preserve_history()
triggers.functionDefinition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.party_auth_link_preserve_history()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog'
AS $function$
BEGIN
  IF TG_OP='DELETE' OR (to_jsonb(NEW)-ARRAY['revoked_at','revoked_by','revocation_reason'])
    IS DISTINCT FROM (to_jsonb(OLD)-ARRAY['revoked_at','revoked_by','revocation_reason'])
    OR (OLD.revoked_at IS NOT NULL AND to_jsonb(NEW) IS DISTINCT FROM to_jsonb(OLD)) THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'PARTY_AUTH_LINK_HISTORY_IMMUTABLE' USING ERRCODE='23514';
  END IF;
  RETURN NEW;
END;
$function$

triggers.definition: CREATE TRIGGER preschool_teacher_confirmation_truncate_guard BEFORE TRUNCATE ON preschool_teacher_branch_confirmations FOR EACH STATEMENT EXECUTE FUNCTION preschool_teacher_history_truncate_guard()
triggers.functionDefinition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.preschool_teacher_history_truncate_guard()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
BEGIN
  IF TG_RELID='public.teacher_assignments'::regclass THEN
    IF EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM public.teacher_assignments WHERE canonical_course_id IS NOT NULL)
    THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'PRESCHOOL_TEACHER_HISTORY_IMMUTABLE' USING ERRCODE='23514'; END IF;
  ELSIF TG_RELID='public.preschool_teacher_branch_confirmations'::regclass THEN
    IF EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM public.preschool_teacher_branch_confirmations)
    THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'PRESCHOOL_TEACHER_HISTORY_IMMUTABLE' USING ERRCODE='23514'; END IF;
  ELSE RAISE EXCEPTION 'PRESCHOOL_TEACHER_TRUNCATE_GUARD_SCOPE' USING ERRCODE='23514'; END IF;
  RETURN NULL;
END $function$

helperDefinitions.definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.preschool_course_assignment_visible(p_tenant_id uuid, p_course_id uuid, p_branch_id uuid)
 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE sql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog', 'public', 'pg_temp'
AS $function$
  SELECT public.preschool_branch_access(p_tenant_id,auth.uid(),p_branch_id,'registry')
    AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM public.edu_courses WHERE id=p_course_id AND tenant_id=p_tenant_id);
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.preschool_enrollment_assignment_visible(p_tenant_id uuid, p_enrollment_id uuid, p_course_id uuid, p_branch_id uuid, p_request_id uuid)
 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE sql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog', 'public', 'pg_temp'
AS $function$
  SELECT public.preschool_branch_access(p_tenant_id,auth.uid(),p_branch_id,'registry') AND EXISTS(
    SELECT 1 FROM public.edu_enrollments e JOIN public.edu_courses c ON c.id=e.course_id AND c.tenant_id=e.tenant_id
    JOIN public.students s ON s.party_id=e.student_party_id AND s.tenant_id=e.tenant_id
    JOIN public.party_parties p ON p.id=e.student_party_id AND p.tenant_id=e.tenant_id AND p.party_type='person' AND p.deleted_at IS NULL
    JOIN public.preschool_chain_course_branch_assignments a ON a.tenant_id=e.tenant_id AND a.course_id=e.course_id
    WHERE e.id=p_enrollment_id AND e.tenant_id=p_tenant_id AND e.course_id=p_course_id
      AND e.request_id=p_request_id::text AND a.branch_id=p_branch_id);
$function$
